title: Ars Notoria
subtitle: The Notory Art — rapid learning through prayer, notae, and study
era: 13th–14th c. (Versions A/B); practice method modernized in 20th–21st c.

ecosystem_role.summary: Ars Notoria is the bridge grimoire: Grimoirer owns read/assets/calendar; Stonedoorway owns imaginal runtime (journey, audio, Bruno memory, phoneme worlds).

tier_a_public_domain: PD manuscript plates (Yale Mellon MS 1, Clm 276 samples, etc.)
Our original cheatsheets, non-negotiables, calendar templates
never_publish_on_grimoirer: proprietary prayer packs from paid editions without licence
rights.policy: link, don't redistribute modern copyrighted editions

sources_local.review_note: Dan Harms review of Skinner Vol.2 (Version B method): https://danharms.wordpress.com/2021/10/05/review-ars-notoria-the-method-version-b-medieval-angel-magic/ — practitioner-oriented reorganization by art; timing tables; notae from BnF Lat 9336; prayers often from Turner English; appendices include ecclesiastical/planetary hours. Treat as practice guide, not critical edition.

practice_profile.then: specials — one liberal art at a time
practice_profile.order_note: Philosophy specials first; trivium before quadrivium
practice_profile.core_loop: intention → general → nota → special → immediate study → log
practice_profile.tea_note: Saffron/rosewater is a Version B material formula only. Castle interim: not necessary. Turner never requires it.
essential_non_negotiables: study the art immediately after the rite
contemplate one nota (not a scroll of notes)
discipline shell (historical: chastity/mortal-sin avoidance; modern: clear head, no intoxicants for the sitting)
optional_layers: full penitence window (~15 days as able)

bruno_bridge.grammar_room: Pāṇini machine / sandhi gates as notoria grammar special
bruno_bridge.session_template: INTENTION faculty → PURIFY optional → FIGURE hub → INSPECTION contractio → VOICE prayer/chant → WORK study → RETURN log

notoria_timing_layers.rule: fixed weekly slots — consistency over purity
sessions on 4th / 8th / 12th moon days if tracking moon
greater ritual phases: penitence → 3-day opening (Fri near new moon) → interim → 4 lunar months of operation (trivium then quadrivium; one art at a time) → closing
Mercury day/hour for study/writing arts if already using planetary hours
